title: Zyther
description: A resource pack that adds a bunch of cool textures to Minecraft
body: About the PackThis resource pack delivers a complete aesthetic overhaul to your Minecraft world, upgrading your gear, building essentials, and audio experience. It blends sharp, custom weapon designs with beautiful block textures and custom audio tracks to breathe fresh life into your survival or PvP adventures.Key FeaturesUpgraded Arsenal: Brand new textures for all swords, tools, and full armor sets to make you look legendary in combat.Refreshed Terrain: Revamped block designs that give worlds and builds a clean, cohesive, and modern look.Custom Audio: Replacement soundtracks and audio enhancements for your favorite music discs.
